purpose: Repair the released RequirementsGathering circuit by adding the reusable bounded OpenSpec adapter that the release contract promises but did not previously ship.

included: canonical RequirementsGathering output normalization and persistence
public package exports, documentation, and generic fixtures
excluded: OpenSpec CLI execution or interoperability claims
changes to approved project baselines or persisted lifecycle state

acceptance: The adapter has no feature-specific answers or hidden project context.
A fresh effect calls the host executor exactly once and Core replay calls it zero times.
Native proposal and clarification responses are strictly validated and normalized into declared outcomes only.
Clarification continuation is exact, checkpoint-bound, and independent of conversational memory.
Malformed output, binding drift, provider substitution, and authority-bearing operations fail closed.
Two unrelated feature fixtures execute through requirements-gathering@0.1.0.
maturity: reusable executable adapter with host-supplied capability executor
